scope:
Pinned C++ raw Value metadata fixtures, independent of parsed DEFAULT trees.

The tiny helper links each already-built reference library; it does not rebuild
DuckDB. Hex payloads preserve floating bits, declared widths and typed NULLs.

cases.name: typed_null
cases.type: STRUCT(a DECIMAL(12,2), b TIME WITH TIME ZONE[])

cases.name: decimal_widths
cases.type: STRUCT(s DECIMAL(4,1), i DECIMAL(9,2), b DECIMAL(18,3), h DECIMAL(38,1))[]

cases.name: integers
cases.type: STRUCT(i8 TINYINT, i16 SMALLINT, i32 INTEGER, i64 BIGINT, i128 HUGEINT, u8 UTINYINT, u16 USMALLINT, u32 UINTEGER, u64 UBIGINT, u128 UHUGEINT)

cases.name: strings
cases.type: STRUCT(s VARCHAR[], b BLOB[], uuid UUID, "bit" BIT, n BIGNUM, huge BIGNUM, e ENUM('', 'A', 'a'))

cases.name: temporal
cases.type: STRUCT(d DATE[], t TIME, z TIME WITH TIME ZONE[], s TIMESTAMP_S, ms TIMESTAMP_MS, us TIMESTAMP, ns TIMESTAMP_NS, tz TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, i INTERVAL)

cases.name: union
cases.expression: [union_value(i:=42)::UNION(i INTEGER,s VARCHAR), union_value(s:=NULL::VARCHAR)::UNION(i INTEGER,s VARCHAR), NULL]
